title: Finite randomized constraint satisfaction input
statement: Given a constraint template over a finite label set, a finite randomized constraint satisfaction input consists of a natural number of variables, a constraint satisfaction instance on the canonical variable set of that size, and a randomized assignment specifying a marginal label distribution for each variable.
hypotheses_covered: Constraint template over that label set
